name_reason: Compliant and accurate. data_fd2_ prefix (game global); domain 'shared' (used across menu/save/load/recruit/promotion/battle-dialog code); descriptor 'menu_party_roster_buffer_ptr' reflects both the data type (a pointer, _ptr, to a heap buffer) and the role (the out-of-battle menu/template party roster). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix matching its own or any data address). The legacy alias 'map_terrain_buffer' still appears in some caller plate comments but is superseded by this name.
purpose: Base pointer of the out-of-battle menu/template party roster: a heap buffer holding the permanent recruited party as fixed-size character records.
logic_summary: uint32 pointer slot, zero-initialized in the image (BSS). Sole writer is main @ 0x25BF4, which does = (uint32)malloc(0xA00) once at startup (verified: get_xrefs_to shows exactly one WRITE site). 0xA00 = 2560 bytes = 32 entries of 0x50 (80) bytes each = 32 runtime_char records (matches FD2's 32-character roster). ~29 reader sites (verified: 29 READ xrefs across menu/save/load/recruit/promotion code) walk it as an array with stride 0x50, bounded by data_fd2_shared_menu_party_member_count @ 0x53BFB. Slot 0 = lord (never moved by reorder). It is the permanent recruited party, distinct from data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr @ 0x53A45 (the per-chapter active-battle copy). Representative readers verified: fd2_find_char_by_id_or_template @ 0x12CBB (pChar=base; for i<member_count: if *(byte*)(pChar+8)==id ...; pChar+=0x50), fd2_reorder_party_by_selection @ 0x32127 (snapshot all 0xA00 then reorder by 0x50 stride), fd2_save_current_state_to_slot @ 0x300CD (memmove of the whole 0xA00 chunk to/from the FD2.SAV slot).
element_semantics: 32-bit address slot; points to a heap buffer of 0xA00 bytes = 32 contiguous 0x50-byte runtime_char records (the menu/template party roster). Buffer is block-copied to/from the FD2.SAV slot as one 0xA00 chunk and walked elementwise with stride 0x50 indexed by the menu party member count.
notes: Global data symbol (not a function); get_function_by_address and get_plate_comment correctly returned 'no function'. src comment block (src/life/main.c lines 718-748) was already thorough and accurate; every claim cross-checked against decompilation (malloc 0xA00 sole writer, 0x50 stride, BSS zero-init, FD2.SAV block-copy) and kept unchanged. Ghidra PLATE_COMMENT at 0x53BF7 was null; created a concise plate (len 653) via run_script_inline + cu.setComment(CodeUnit.PLATE_COMMENT, ...) reflecting the src conclusion. No src .c edit was needed (comment kept), so the only staged file is this shard.
